emptyCols.description:
If true, fields which are empty for all values (or at least the initial set of values) are still represented
as columns, even though all cells will be empty. This is useful if the #initialLoad rows are not representative
of the latter data.

initialLoad.description:
How many rows to load initially. These rows will be the ones used to determine which columns to show, so it
should be large enough to be representative.

expandColCount.description: If embedded Obj instances have this many or fewer fields specified, those will be automatically expanded.

expandColsDeep.description: If embedded Obj instances themselves have embedded Obj instances, #expandColCount is applied recursively.

includeFields.description: If building from a collection of object values, show the named fields as columns.

title:
Options for loading the data grid. By default, 100 rows are loaded initially and the displayed columns are based
on which fields have values.
name: DataGrid.LoadSpec
